items.title: Lee Simpson (founder of Jefferson City Buzzards) Interview, 1948-06-09
items.who: Lee Simpson (founder of Jefferson City Buzzards)
items.q: a man by the name of Adam Habs, who was a member of the club, he was the bass drum player.

ctx.x: And the, uh... It's Brother Mark, another old member. Thank you, Mark. Um, Mr. Simpson, will you give us a short background sketch of yourself? Thank you.

Brother Simpson, did you tell the boys about the terrain we had on the trees these nights? That we went to Brother Lock's house and had some boiled wine, and what happened to our field family when we was coming up Camp Street? How is? We visited our grand morse's house, Mr. Louis Lock. And they had enough of stuff there to float a steamboat. And some of the boys imagined that they were steamboats. And got tanked up. And we had at that time the Burgeon's drum and five-coats from both the members of the Burgeon.…
That is one of the incidents of the Lock's visit.
